body:
## Summary

`DeleteObjects` (bulk) — `POST /bucket?delete` with an XML body of keys — returns **400 InvalidRequest** (bucket-only path guard, `crates/gateway-s3/src/lib.rs:245-251`). `aws s3 rm --recursive` and `aws s3 sync --delete` rely on it; without it, deletes are one-request-per-object at best.

## Scope for Alpha
- Route `POST /bucket?delete` to a bulk handler; parse the `<Delete><Object><Key>…` XML body.
- Delete each key via the existing single-object delete path (dirent+inode CAS unlink + orphan grace record).
- Return the S3 `<DeleteResult>` XML (per-key `<Deleted>` / `<Error>`), honoring `Quiet` mode.

## Acceptance
- `aws s3 rm s3://b/prefix --recursive` and `aws s3 sync --delete` remove the expected keys and report per-key results.

Part of the 0.1-Alpha S3 completion epic (P1).

milestone.description: First tagged release (Alpha). Scheduled after the two production-metadata milestones complete: #14 (Metadata Store FoundationDB) and #5 (M4 — Production metadata backend) — i.e. after the FDB go/no-go (#442) records go, the default flips to FDB, and TiKV development stands down (#443). No due date yet; it follows those two. Starts empty as the release marker.

title: s3: implement DeleteObjects (bulk POST ?delete)
